summary: First-run full-stack testing of Sojaru headless storefront against live WooCommerce. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering store config, categories, products (filters/search/pagination/orderby), product-by-slug, variations, related, coupon 404, auth (register/login/me/duplicate/bad-password), profile update, account orders, and real WooCommerce order creation. Frontend: home, mega-menu, category page, search dialog, variable-product PDP (variation selection + price update + add-to-cart enabling), cart drawer, checkout end-to-end, order confirmation with payment_url, register->/account with Orders/Profile/Address tabs, and new order visible under Account>Orders — all working.

minor.issue: Ordering by price uses Woo default which sorts as strings for meta_value in some setups; on live store output was correctly sorted ascending so passes, but flag for regression if pricing becomes numeric-string edge cases.
No server-side validation that at least one line_item is present or that quantity>0 — relies on Woo to reject.

If WooCommerce customer creation fails (e.g., email already exists in WC), local user is still created with wc_customer_id=null; subsequent /api/account/orders returns [] silently. Consider surfacing warning to client.

ui_bugs.issue: Empty search (/search with no q) shows "Results for \"\"" and lists ALL 14 products instead of an empty state / prompt to type.
Radix DialogContent used without DialogTitle/Description — throws a11y console errors on every open. Wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle.

issues: Tab label reads 'Address' (singular) while spec/product language says 'Addresses' — minor copy inconsistency.

action_items: Fix /search empty-query behavior — render an empty state / prompt instead of listing all products.
Add DialogTitle (with VisuallyHidden if hidden) to SearchDialog and CartDrawer to remove Radix a11y warnings.
Optionally surface a soft warning in /api/auth/register response when WC customer creation fails (wc_customer_id null).
Consider renaming Account tab from 'Address' to 'Addresses' for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses '*' as default with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins. Since app uses Bearer tokens via Authorization header this is fine today, but if cookies are ever used, set explicit origins.
wc_request has no retries/circuit-breaker; a transient Woo 5xx maps to 502 and breaks user flow. Consider 1-retry with backoff for GETs.
In-memory _cache dict is fine for single-worker dev but will fragment across workers in prod — move to Redis or accept eventual inconsistency.
server.py is 456 lines but still cohesive; monitor for growth and split into routers/{auth,catalog,orders}.py once >700.
test_credentials: Register-on-demand test user pattern: email=testpup_<uuid8>@sojaru.co.in, password=sojaru123. Real customers created in live WooCommerce (expected per problem statement).
seed_data_creation: Tests create real WC customers and one real (unpaid, COD) WooCommerce order per full run — this is expected per user note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and must be run with `pytest -n 0` because /app/backend/pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope but the tests share module-level STATE and must run sequentially. All 20 tests pass. Frontend flows verified: home, mega-menu -> /category/*, search dialog, variable PDP variation selection, add-to-cart, cart drawer, /checkout (COD) -> order confirmation with payment_url, register->/account with Orders/Profile/Address tabs, Account>Orders reflects newly-placed orders. Live store: https://www.sojaru.co.in — orders and customers created during tests are real (unpaid).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Only UX polish items above.
